rubric: Device, system and symptom named in one line; the one question (iPhone or Android, Windows or Mac) asked only when the path depends on it, else both paths.
Likely cause in plain words with how likely; 6 to 8 steps in cost order with exact menu paths and what the user should see after each; restart first.
The 'if it works, done; if not, tell me what happened at step N' check; a stop line (heat, swelling, data loss without backup, warranty, company device).
Backup said before anything that deletes or resets; never a command, registry edit, 'cleaner' app, remote-control tool or a number from a pop-up.
Never asks for passwords or codes; lost accounts and phones go through the service's official recovery path.
